# اِنْمَحَصْتِ (inmaḥaṣti) /in.ma.ħasˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْمَحَصَ (inmaḥaṣa)
# اِنْمَحَصَتْ (inmaḥaṣat) /in.ma.ħa.sˤat/: third-pe
